notes: 2nd edition by Deloitte's count. Deloitte Consulting 'mPredictions' for 2003 (mobile only), known from Deloitte's press release of 9 January 2003 on dc.com, read from the Internet Archive. The report PDF was not found: Wayback CDX for dc.com (all PDFs 2002 to 2004, and URLs containing 'predict') and for deloitte.com/dtt/ (all PDFs) lists no 2003 mobile predictions file. Entries are press-release statements in release order; titles are Hindsight's labels; the report's own count and headlines are unknown.
